projects.head: 61b69c5ed5c5f06f8907a052ee166a7c01e994ad
projects.practical_disposition: Phase 1 remains preserved with final result APPROVED_SPACE_EXHAUSTED / RESEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Phase 2 mean-reversion v2 completed its final authorized mechanical index implementation and passed 12 focused tests, all 266 repository tests, Ruff, strict Mypy, compilation, and source-safety checks. The required 36-partition development-data validation reconstructed 790,558 rows per asset and completed its diagnostic internal stages in about 178 seconds, but failed while serializing the required final artifact because a datetime remained non-JSON-serializable. The run therefore produced no complete production-validation artifact and cannot be promoted. Under the user's hard stop, btc-eth-long-only-mean-reversion-v2 is terminally classified IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED_REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED / IMPLEMENTATION_INCONCLUSIVE / NO_ECONOMIC_RESULT; it is not unprofitable, HISTORICAL_NO_GO, or DATA_NO_GO, and no formal economic evaluation or performance result exists. Route 2, btc-eth-relative-value-rotation-v2, is authorized but not yet preregistered and has not accessed market data. Partial controller, test, trace, and reconciliation observations are not evidence of trading profitability. Every Phase 2 final holdout remains closed and unread, no candidate is promoted, capital remains zero, and Vertcoin mining is unchanged.
